name: Tina
source: The self-proclaimed Love Fairy Tina suddenly appears before [url=/c18180]Yuuma[/url] one day. Having no place to go, this mysterious girl settles at Yuma’s place. Her goal is apparently to have Yuuma fall in love with a girl and to fulfill that love. Her special skills are "sleeping together", "eating together", "holding hands when leaving the house" and more amazing stuff. On top of her head rests her familiar [url=/c21640]Kotarou[/url] who possesses terrifying powers (according to her).
